An orchestration must have two or three foundation or processing dependencies and must not mix them.

Back to STXO rulesRead The Standard source

What The Standard says

An orchestration must have two or three foundation or processing dependencies and must not mix them. The analyser reports this as a warning at the declaration or statement that needs attention.

Why it matters

This rule belongs to the Orchestration services family. Following it keeps responsibilities and intent visible to readers, tooling and future maintainers.

Bad code example

// Violates STXO001: An orchestration must have two or three foundation or processing dependencies and must not mix them.
class StudentOrchestrationService(
    IStudentService students,
    ISchoolProcessingService schools) : IStudentOrchestrationService { }

Good code example

// Follows STXO001
class StudentOrchestrationService(
    IStudentService students,
    ISchoolService schools) : IStudentOrchestrationService { }
